# Think in Italian

> Think in Italian is an AI-powered Italian language learning platform offering audio courses, interactive stories, and personalized conversation practice to help learners achieve fluency.

The platform combines 250+ audio lessons, 1200+ bilingual stories, and an AI tutor created by Italian linguists to provide immersive, conversation-focused Italian learning. With 4000+ student testimonials and a mobile app, Think in Italian specializes in helping learners think and speak Italian naturally.
